plate_findings.evidence: General lipodystrophy visible on the body.
Sparse eyebrows and eyelashes, scalp hypotrichosis mentioned in caption.
Distinctive progeroid facial features, including hydrocephalic cranium, triangular face, midface hypoplasia, and beak-shaped nose (caption and visual).

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Panel A provides a general clinical view of the 7-year-old patient, showing signs of generalized lipodystrophy and overall progeroid presentation consistent with the article's focus. B: Panel B is a profile view showing characteristic facial dysmorphisms, such as the triangular face, low-set ears, and features related to the progeroid presentation, which are key clinical indicators.

panels.figure_caption: (a,b): Phenotypic features of an affected individual at age 7 years. Images show the distinctive progeroid facial features, including a general lipodystrophy with distinctive local accumulations of fat, a hydrocephalic cranium, a prominent venous network, pronounced massive frontal tubercles, a triangular face with midface hypoplasia, sparse eyebrows and eyelashes, a scalp hypotrichosis, low-set ears, a beak-shaped nose, a short philtrum, deep-set eyes, and a wide mouth.
in_text_mentions: The proband, a 7-year-old female Russian patient (Figure 1), underwent a comprehensive examination conducted by a pediatric endocrinologist at Sechenov University Hospital in the presence of her parents. Neonatal progeroid syndrome was suspected, so it prompted the necessity of subsequent evaluation by a clinical geneticist at the Research Centre for Medical Genetics. The marriage of the proband’s parents was non-consanguineous (Figure 2).
